about: Survey outpost = cabin + console. Unreal cm, site-relative; the site pivot is the cabin pivot: on the ground under the centre of the deck. +X is the front (open bay, ramp). Verdance and Cinder differ by material instance only.

pieces.name: Cabin
pieces.note: Everything below Z = 0 is piles under the seven feet and the ramp toe (hidden on flat ground).

pieces.name: Console
pieces.note: Pivot bottom-centre, screens face +X. Stands on the bay floor against the back wall, centred between the bay walls. Material slot 0: scalar ScreenPower (default 1.6) is the screens' brightness.

console_interact.note: The pilot stands 51 cm in front of the desk edge, feet on the bay floor, looking along -X.

walk_path_site_cm.what: ground in front of the ramp toe (ramp toe is at X = 626)
top of the ramp (slope 19.2 deg, 385 cm run, 141 cm rise)
deck in front of the bay (13 cm step up to the bay floor at X = 112)

clear_in_front_of_console.note: console front at X = 24.5; bay floor ends X = 112 (13 cm step down to the deck); deck edge X = 228

placement_rules: Put the site pivot ON the ground; do not sink it (the deck is 140 cm up on 118 cm legs). The piles cover a drop of up to 150 cm under any foot.
Keep 3 m of flat ground in front of the ramp toe (site X 626 to 930, Y -5 to 145).
Yaw the whole site freely; never scale it (door and ramp clearances are sized for the 180 cm pilot).
